filter: eq/ne/lt/le on declared columns and literals, NULL comparison is false
projection_order: input row order, then declared output field order
named: materialized once on first ref; inline each ref; earlier definitions only
source_rows: Each scan row has unique row_id text and x integer within this scan. Separate scan/union/ref occurrences remain separate.

project: columns: ordered [output_name,expression] pairs with unique names
relation_fields.named: Top-level definition {name,reuse:materialized|inline,input}; refs may only name earlier definitions.

evaluation: Rows in input order; project output expressions in declared order; args left to right; union left before right. Filter condition operands evaluate left to right, UNKNOWN is not retained.
type_errors: Reject malformed structure/unknown names before function execution. Runtime function errors fail the run, retaining prior call audit.
